summary: Cooper-Standard Holdings Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting an amendment to its ABL credit facility. On September 3, 2026, subsidiaries CS Intermediate Holdco 1 LLC, Cooper-Standard Automotive Inc., Cooper-Standard Automotive Canada Limited and others entered Amendment No. 6 to the Third Amended and Restated Loan Agreement with Bank of America as agent. The amendment upsized commitments by $20 million to $200 million, extended maturity to September 3, 2031, lowered SOFR/CORRA margins to 150-200 bps and base-rate margins to 50-100 bps, and removed credit spread adjustments. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation.
